rationale: The branch review read every changed file and reports no open findings, and all final gates are green. I spot-checked the riskiest file, runtime.ts, plus its runtime-calltool.ts helpers. The escape gate runs before policy.check and returns the exact refusal recorded through logCall. It only affects Bash and Exec identities, and only for exact boolean true. Allowed calls convert to an ask unless the mode is raw, denials pass through unchanged, and the suffix reaches every ask the call raises. This matches the US-005 and US-006 spec. The complexity baseline only shrank, from 56 to 53 for RunCommand run. The extra docs file came from the feature's own planning commit. All twelve deferred minors are hazards unreachable today or wording and label gaps, and none should block shipping. CI still has to pass on the pushed head.
